The '''Republic Historical Database''' was one of the data storehouses maintained by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during its last decades. It contained information regarding the history of the Republic's member [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].

==Known entries in the database==
*Subdirectory ORT571-23,794,928-2N: The relationship of planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] with the rest of the Republic throughout history
*Subdirectory ORT571-23,794,928/4N: Naboo's royal court protocols and their evolution
